data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word ἁλιαρός (haliaros), which means 'cheerful, merry'. In Christian tradition, Hilar is the name of several saints, including Hilarion of Gaza and Hilaria of Thebes. The name Hilar carries the meaning “Cheerful, Merry” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hilar usually hope their child will grow to embody cheerful, merry and live with faith, good character and purpose.
